scorecard.name: Took ownership of the problem
scorecard.coaching: The agent attempted to deflect responsibility at [01:21] by telling the customer that remote controls are consumable accessories and instructing him to purchase a replacement at Argos himself before troubleshooting.

grader.scenario: TV Bluetooth voice remote control unresponsive; agent deflects ownership by telling caller to buy one at Argos before troubleshooting
grader.notes: The agent successfully diagnosed and resolved a Bluetooth remote unpairing issue by guiding the customer through infrared recovery mode. However, the agent failed Took Ownership of the Problem at minute 2 by attempting to deflect responsibility, telling the customer that remotes are wear-and-tear accessories and that he should buy a replacement himself from Argos.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: [00:24] Agent: '...may I please verify your billing address and your security question answer?' - Completed within the first 60 seconds.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: [06:48] Agent: 'Just to check, Marcus, is your broadband internet and WiFi connection at home operating smoothly as well right now?' - Harmless recheck of broadband connectivity.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: [01:21] Agent: 'Look, remote controls are technically classed as consumable wear-and-tear accessories under our terms, so you really should just pop down to Argos or order a universal replacement online yourself.' - Agent deflects ownership instead of troubleshooting.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: [03:45] Agent: 'Obviously that confirms the physical buttons, circuit board, and batteries are in working order, Marcus.' - Professional, objective explanation.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: [07:18] Voice search, channel switching, and recordings confirmed operational by customer.
